WINNABILITY, measured against every live row (comparison-2026-07-30): the sharpest latent is NOT one the bounce named. De La Rosa Strawberry & Vanilla Marshmallows | Baker's | $3.19 / 14.5 oz = $0.22/oz is PRICED IN BAND inside strawberries and TODAY already beats two real strawberry rows (Hy-Vee Wish Farms 0.2494, Family Fare 0.2806). The Baker's strawberries cell is a SALE (Kroger Sliced 4 lb BIG DEAL 0.1561); when that sale lapses, any Baker's everyday fresh price above 0.22/oz makes the marshmallow bag the published Baker's strawberries CELL - no crown flip required. The crown itself needs Aldi 0.1181 / Sams 0.1225 / Walmart 0.1475 / Fareway 0.18 to rise above 0.22, i.e. one off-season week. The estate's own strawberries band max (0.60/oz) says prices up to 0.60 are plausible strawberry territory, so no defensible band can stop a 0.22 marshmallow: routing is the only fix.

ROOT MECHANISM 1 - the class library is missing exactly 7 expressible tokens: category-excludes.json already owns this failure class (its note: single source of truth for wrong-class product tokens) and its beverage class even lists tea in the EXEMPT regex, yet no class carries a tea / coffee / v8 / marshmallow / rice-cake / tampon / lip-balm token. audit-food-category (the blocking cell guard) reads the same library, so it is structurally blind to all 7 of these estate-wide today.

ROOT MECHANISM 2 - THE BAKE HAS DRIFTED 2,165 PATTERNS BEHIND THE LIBRARY: apply-category-excludes.ps1 -WhatIf (read-only, run by the reviewer) reports +2165 patterns across 443 commodities. The library grew (snack_carrier gained jerky, crisps, crackers tokens and more) but the bake was never re-run, so the garlic exclude list still predates snack_carrier entirely - which is exactly why Krave Beef Jerky could reach garlic even though the library already knows jerky is wrong on every Fruit/Vegetables commodity. The workflow doc says register -> apply -> compare; nothing enforces the apply step and no guard watches bake currency. This is the job-whose-cadence-cannot-keep-up shape.

ROOT MECHANISM 3 - category scoping holes: milk (Dairy & Eggs), rice (Pasta), chocolate-chips (Baking), bagels (Bread), honey and peanuts (Coffee, Oils & Spreads), canned-black-beans (Canned), bacon (Meat) receive only babyfood/pet/household/supplement classes from the apply rules, so bakery/dairy/snack tokens can never reach them via the library. Those routes need per-commodity tokens (the library's own rule: anything item-specific stays in the commodity's exclude list).

FOUND-WHILE-MEASURING live wrong cell: Ranch Style Beans with Sliced Jalapeno Peppers | Baker's | $1.25 / 15 oz = 0.0833/oz HOLDS the pickled-jalapenos Baker's cell (a published store cell; the crown is Sams 0.0677 so it is not the crown). Full-corpus scan: it is the ONLY one of 533 beans-carrying names that routes to pickled-jalapenos, so the exclude is surgical. After eject, the Baker's cell becomes La Costena Sliced Jalapeno Peppers 28 oz $3.19 = 0.1139/oz - real pickled jalapenos; the cell price RISES because the wrong cheap product leaves.

surface_fix.what: route all 9 misroutes (plus the found bean can and 4 second-order landings the measurement exposed) to their right owners via excludes; every wrong product has a correct commodity later in its eligibility chain or is a non-food that must go unmatched
surface_fix.exact_change: LIBRARY (category-excludes.json): add the class tokens and the new snack_carrier exempt exactly as spelled in change_tokens below (the exempt is load-bearing: without it the re-bake ejects 7 real apple products - Cosmic Crisp / Honeycrisp / Rockit Crisp variety names match the crisps token - and Simple Truth Organic Honey Crisp Apples would land in the HONEY commodity; measured). COMMODITY-LEVEL (commodities.json): add the exclude tokens per commodity and the two refried-beans include patterns exactly as spelled in change_tokens. THEN RUN apply-category-excludes.ps1 once (the bake): expect roughly +2170 patterns across roughly 443 commodities; afterwards -WhatIf must report +0 patterns.

change_tokens.second_order_rationale: chili-crisp excludes cashews because PLANTERS Garlic Chili Crisp cashews would otherwise land there after leaving garlic, and chili-crisp has NO band; tea-bags excludes scent-words because the Dove 8-bar soap (Green Tea Scent, no soap word in the name) would land there after leaving cucumbers; protein-bars excludes crisps because Quaker Protein rice crisps would land there after leaving rice; bagels excludes breakfast-sandwich because the Simple Truth bagel breakfast sandwiches would land there after leaving bacon. All four demonstrated in the measured diff, none has any other estate-wide match.

items.root_cause: First-match-wins can only be as good as the exclude walls, and three separate mechanisms had holes: (a) seven wrong-product classes the library cannot express today (tea, coffee, v8, marshmallow, rice-cake, tampon, lip-balm) - so neither the baked excludes NOR the blocking audit-food-category guard can see them anywhere in the estate; (b) the bake step is manual and has silently drifted 2,165 patterns behind the library across 443 commodities, so even tokens the library HAS (jerky) protect nothing - jerky-on-garlic is purely this; (c) category scoping does not give dairy/bread/baking/pasta/canned/meat commodities the bakery/dairy/snack classes, so those misroutes need per-commodity tokens, which nobody had written because nothing surfaces a CANDIDATE-level wrong product until it is one sale from a cell (match-soundness flags them as contested, but the round-1 review checked each commodity crown instead of each product routing - the process gap the bounce correctly named). The bounce's other premise - missing sanity bands - is measured FALSE: all 21 involved commodities are banded and the bands demonstrably fired (candidates-2026-07-30 OUT-OF-BAND stamps on the exact rows); bands are also the wrong tool, because a 0.22/oz marshmallow is inside any band that still admits the real 0.2494 Hy-Vee strawberries. STRUCTURAL ANSWER TO THE DISPATCH QUESTION: the right fix is routing repair through the designed library + re-bake + measured commodity tokens (option a, done properly through the library); NOT option b new bands (nothing to add - the set is fully banded and bands cannot separate in-band wrong products); NOT option d leave-it (the marshmallow already outprices two real strawberry rows and the tea is one 21-cent price move from the lemons crown).

root_fix.what: make bake currency a WATCHED invariant so mechanism (b) can never silently recur: apply-category-excludes.ps1 gains a -Root parameter (default $PSScriptRoot, live behavior byte-identical) and test-auditors gains a bake-currency case: a live run of apply-category-excludes.ps1 -WhatIf must report +0 patterns, and a frozen mini fixture tree (commodities.json missing one baked pattern) must report a NONZERO count - the must-fire proving the drift detector still detects drift. Same fixture-reachability pattern 3014ab5c used for audit-ff-carry.
root_fix.exact_change: apply-category-excludes.ps1: param gains [string]$Root with default empty and $root = if ($Root) { $Root } else { $PSScriptRoot }. test-auditors.ps1: new case running the script twice - default root expecting +0 patterns across 0 commodities in the output, and -Root at a frozen fixture dir (minimal commodities.json + categories.json + category-excludes.json with one class pattern deliberately absent from the commodity exclude) expecting a +1 patterns report. Fixture files are FROZEN literals, never regenerated from live data.

items.resolution_note: Round-2 adjudication of all 17 contested products, each routed in array order with its raw row: 8 route correctly, 9 misroute. None held a cell; what protected the board was 4 band drops + 5 unit-refusals, and for the in-band wrong candidates only price levels - the sharpest being De La Rosa marshmallows at 0.22/oz inside strawberries, already beating two real strawberry rows today. Root causes: 7 tokens the class library could not express, a bake 2,165 patterns behind the library (why garlic missed the existing jerky token), and category-scoping holes needing per-commodity tokens. Shipped: 7 library tokens + apples exempt + 20 commodity exclude tokens + 2 refried-beans includes + full re-bake, measured over 26,003 names: 130 routing corrections, zero live cell items ejected, four decided cell corrections (mixed-nuts x3 including a crown flip and the Aldi rename continuity, pickled-jalapenos Baker's bean-can eviction), zero new guard fires. Bake currency is now a watched invariant with a must-fire fixture. Bands: unchanged; premise disproven (strawberries and milk bands exist and fired - candidates-file stamps prove it).

SHIPPED, and the frozen 130-name contract REPRODUCED before anything was accepted. Method: a read-only routing snapshot (engine-faithful replica, assign-then-wrap everywhere) over 25,939 distinct names / 22,467 in-feed across 113 capture files, taken BEFORE and AFTER the change and diffed against expected_routing_changes. Result: 131 names changed routing, of which 128 are the contract verbatim. Every one of the 130 contract lines fired; none went missing. audit-match-soundness independently reported MOVED=63 DROPPED=47 with drift-vs-engine=0, which reconciles to the same three-line delta below, and after -Accept it reports 0/0/0.

THREE MEASURED DIFFERENCES FROM THE PLAN, all of them the plan's own intent, none a new mechanism:
(1) 'La Costena Black Beans, Refried 20.5 Oz' and 'La Preferida Black Beans, Refried 16 Oz' land in REFRIED-BEANS, not <unmatched> as the frozen list says. That is what the plan's own new include 'black\s+beans,?\s+refried' does - the comma form matches it. Verified by rule replay before the edit (include hit, no exclude hit, no GLOBAL_EXCLUDE hit) and confirmed live. Better than the contract: two real refried-bean cans get their correct owner instead of being dropped. They lose there to Casa Mamita 0.0619, so no cell moved.
(2) 'Ranch Style Beans with Sliced Jalapeno Peppers' -> <unmatched> is the ONE changed name absent from expected_routing_changes - and it is the plan's own found-while-measuring correction, carried in its evidence, its change_tokens (pickled-jalapenos exclude \bbeans\b) and its expected_cell_changes. Only the routing line was missing from the frozen list.
(3) The bake reported +3687 patterns across 445 commodities, not the plan's "roughly +2170 across roughly 443". The plan's estimate counted the pre-existing drift (measured here at exactly +2165 across 443 before any edit, as predicted) but not the fan-out of the SEVEN NEW library tokens across the scoped categories (household x2 reaches every scoped commodity, beverage x3 reaches Fruit/Vegetables/Meat, candy and snack_carrier reach Fruit/Vegetables). A pattern-count estimate, not a behavioural difference: the behaviour is the 130-name diff, and that reproduced.

BOARD DIFF, 2833 cells before and after: ZERO cells lost, ZERO added, 8 changed. THREE are the plan's expected corrections to the cent - mixed-nuts @ Walmart 0.3675 -> 0.3548 (crown flips Aldi -> Walmart), mixed-nuts @ Baker's 0.4359 -> 0.4279, pickled-jalapenos @ Baker's 0.0833 -> 0.1139 (the bean can out, La Costena Sliced Jalapeno Peppers 28 oz in, price RISES because the wrong cheap product left). The FOURTH expected change was a non-change by design and verified as such: mixed-nuts @ Aldi holds 0.3654 on the renamed Southern Grove row, so the cell survives the store rename instead of dying when the old-name capture ages out.
FIVE CELL CHANGES BEYOND expected_cell_changes, each adjudicated against the candidate rows rather than assumed:
  - FOUR are same-price tie reshuffles with ZERO price movement, caused by contract arrivals joining an existing tie: breakfast-sandwiches @ Baker's (4 products all at 1.3738, Kroger Bacon Egg and Cheese Croissant arrived), canned-black-beans @ Walmart (3 Great Value black bean SKUs all at 0.0573, the refried rows left), iced-tea @ Baker's (4 Kroger gallon teas all at 0.0257, AriZona Lemon Iced Tea arrived), refried-beans @ Baker's (5 Kroger refried SKUs all at 0.0744, Simple Truth Organic Fat Free Refried Black Beans arrived). Every replacement is a legitimate member of its commodity at the identical per-unit price; no published number moved.
  - ONE is a real correction the plan did not propagate to its cell list: rice-cakes @ Family Fare 0.6487 -> 0.5662, because 'Quaker Caramel Chocolate Chip Rice Cakes 7.4 Oz' ($4.19 / 7.4 oz) left chocolate-chips (a contract line) and is genuinely the cheapest Family Fare rice cake. The cell gets cheaper because a real product arrived in its correct commodity.

STEP 9 (pre-ack the 3 expected_new_review_flags) NOT DONE, and deliberately: there is no such thing as an ack key for an out-of-band drop. check-ad-cycles builds review-flag keys in exactly four namespaces (SANITY|commodity|type from guards-<date>.json, MULTIBUY|store|id, BASIS|id|store, PACKBASIS|id|store); band drops are logged to flagged-<date>.json and never page, and review-ack.json's own how_to_ack says to use "the flag key from out\alerted-flags.json". Three invented keys would suppress nothing and would put unverifiable rows in the one file whose value is that every row is a real reviewed suppression. Measured instead: re-running sanity-check.ps1 on the new board gives 48 flags before and 48 after, ZERO new, ZERO cleared, ZERO changed details - this change created no pageable review flag at all. All three arrivals ARE out-of-band exactly as predicted and can never publish (beef-jerky Krave 3.5667 vs max 3; crackers Blue Diamond Nut-Thins 0.9388 vs max 0.6; sandwich-cookies Milano Baker's 6 oz 0.8317 vs max 0.6), verified in flagged-2026-07-31.json.

PROOF THE NEW WATCHERS CAN ACTUALLY FIRE (the 2026-07-29 reachable-self-test lesson): both new cases were run against a negative control, not just observed green. (a) The three frozen food-category rows were replayed against the PRE-CHANGE library in an isolated copy: "ok - no food commodity matched a wrong-class product (3 priced cells scanned)", exit 0 - the exact blindness the plan describes. Against the shipped library all three hard-fail (exit 2) and name household / candy / beverage. (b) The bake-currency must-fire fixture reports "+2 patterns across 1 commodities"; with the ^apples$ exempt removed from a TEMP copy it reports "+4 patterns across 2 commodities", so the shipped assertion is load-bearing on the exempt, not decorative. A fourth check asserts the drifted fixture is still frozen, because one forgotten -WhatIf would bake it and the must-fire would pass forever by finding nothing.

OBSERVED, NOT FIXED, ON PURPOSE: 'Quaker Apple Cinnamon Rice Crisps' (Baker's) first-matches the APPLES commodity, ahead of rice - another instance of the rice-snack class this plan understands. It is unchanged by this change (the ^apples$ snack_carrier exempt leaves the apples exclude list exactly as it was), it is OUT-OF-BAND today so it publishes nothing, and adding a token for it would put a 131st name outside a contract the reviewer froze at 130. Left for the next measured pass, recorded here rather than silently tolerated. The apples exempt is genuinely load-bearing: 7 real apple products in today's corpus carry a Crisp name (Cosmic Crisp x5, Rockit Crisp, Simple Truth Organic Honey Crisp), and without it Honey Crisp apples land in HONEY.
